title: Fear and Anxiety
definition: Fear and anxiety are experiences of dread, worry, uncertainty, and distress that must be brought under the care and truth of God.
summary: Scripture calls believers to bring fear to God rather than be ruled by it. The Lord gives His presence, peace, promises, and help.
christFocus: Christ cares for anxious hearts and calls His people to trust the Father.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture calls believers to bring fear to God rather than be ruled by it. The Lord gives His presence, peace, promises, and help.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
